title.narrative: Central Component of the EU Sustainable Integrated Landscape Management Initiative - Landscapes For Our Future

description.narrative: The Landscapes For Our Future Initiative supports 23 country/regional Actions that contribute to reconciling climate change adaptation and mitigation, ecosystem conservation, sustainable agriculture and food security objectives at the landscape level. This central project will: (a) provide targeted technical and monitoring support to country/regional Actions; (b) capture, generate and communicate knowledge, and (c) facilitate collaborative learning and policy dialogue.
